{{Quote|Find out if any of Night Caller's crew has any aptitude for TIE fighters. Lure them to the simulator with brandy or sweets if you have to.|Wedge Antilles to Wes Janson|<ref name="X-Wing: Wraith Squadron">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>}}
A '''TIE fighter simulator''' was a machine used by [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] to simulate flying a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighter]], usually for training and learning purposes.<ref name="X-Wing: Wraith Squadron" />
